Iteration 15 fixes two dropdown layout issues:

- Corrected the Genres mega-menu so it opens to the right of the Genres control instead of extending off-screen.
- Tightened the language options panel width to better match the reference overlay.
- Rebuilt the production frontend successfully.
- All existing API, auth, profile-isolation, and business-chain behavior remains unchanged and fully passing.
